children: 3D Systems agreed to exchange all $92.03M of its 5.875% secured notes due 2030 for $85.0M of new 3.30% unsecured notes due 2031, 13,471,138 shares and $20.0M cash. Closing is expected on or about November 12, 2026; no cash proceeds go to the company.
The deal retires all secured notes, but closing remains subject to conditions.
The exchange reduces principal by $7.03M and replaces secured debt with unsecured debt.
The coupon is lower than the exchanged notes' 5.875%, reducing stated interest cost on the new principal.
Equity issuance dilutes shareholders, and the cash payment is a use of company funds.
Closing expected on or about Nov. 12, 2026
Completion is not certain; the release says the exchange is subject to closing conditions.

This is a balance-sheet restructuring, not an operating update, with the release describing a proposed exchange of all outstanding secured notes. Completion of the exchange and the resulting debt and lien releases are the next milestones to monitor.
